title: Great tour!
text: Christina was great in giving some of the history of Barcelona.  Her guided tour of the Picasso museum was perfect.

title: Massive museum
text:
Very large museum with many early works.  As i like Picasso's earlier works better this was great for me.  If you are looking or his later more famous works then better go to some of the famous museums around the world.   
Museum is located in a great walking area with many interesting galleries and shops nearby
author: historyfanatic99
